messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@dataharbor.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan request — DataHarbor POC

Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The exec team at DataHarbor wants a crisp mutual action plan so we can move the POC forward this quarter. We need a single source-of-truth that ties milestones to acceptance tests, owners, and dates. High level asks from our side:

- A clear definition of success (both quantitative and UX checks) we can present to our CIO.
- Exit gates for go/no-go decisions at each stage (smoke, scale, signoff).
- A short list of acceptance tests we can run, with pass/fail thresholds.
- A timeline to complete the evaluation and recommended cadence for check-ins.

Can you put together a draft MAP and a proposed close timeline? If possible, include an initial DAG of dependencies. I attached our internal evaluation checklist for reference.

Attachments: DH-eval-criteria-comments.pdf (internal)

Proposed availability for a 30-min alignment call: Thu 4/22 10–12 PT or Fri 4/23 9–11 PT.

Best,
Elena Martinez

Subject: RE: MAP & evaluation plan request — DataHarbor POC

Elena —

Thanks for the note and for sharing your checklist. I put together a lightweight draft MAP (attached) and an acceptance-test checklist to get us moving. High-level proposal below — we can refine on the call.

Summary (one-liner):
Deliver a 6-week POC that demonstrates production-grade latency and quality for your top-3 user flows and provides the artifacts DataHarbor needs for an internal signoff (performance report, security evidence checklist, and rollout risk matrix).

Proposed stages & owners:
- Week 0 (Kickoff): Align success metrics, access + infra (owner: DataHarbor IT / Elena).
- Week 1–2 (Smoke): Basic integration, prefix caching enabled, sanity tests (owner: Redwood eng — Karthik).
- Week 3–4 (Feature validation): Run acceptance tests against 10k sample interactions; measure p95 latency, accuracy proxies, and error modes (owner: Marissa on Ops).
- Week 5 (Scale): Load test at projected concurrency, confirm batching and KV cache behavior (owner: Redwood infra).
- Week 6 (Signoff): Deliver final report and proposed cutover plan (owner: Sean).

Key acceptance tests (examples to be fleshed out in checklist):
- Latency: p95 generation latency <350ms for traced flows with 512 token context.
- Throughput: sustain 200 req/s with end-to-end success rate >99% under the tested workload.
- Quality: sample concordance > 92% vs. labelled ground truth (we'll agree the dataset).
- Failover: automatic fallback to a smaller model within 500ms on GPU eviction.

Exit/decision gates:
- Smoke pass: integration sanity + sample inference correctness.
- Acceptance pass: all core acceptance tests pass within defined thresholds.
- Go/no-go: CTO/CIO review after week 6 with artifacts.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Alignment call Thu 4/22 10:30 PT — confirm owners and dataset.
2) We will share MAP-Draft-v1.xlsx and Acceptance-Test-Checklist.md right after the call.
3) Agree on a single drive folder for artifacts and a shared HubSpot milestone (I linked one below).

I've attached the MAP draft and a short checklist for tests (still editable). If the timeline needs to compress to 4 weeks, we can discuss tradeoffs (reduced sample size, focused flows).

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP-Draft-v1.xlsx; Acceptance-Test-Checklist.md

From: Elena Martinez <elena@dataharbor.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP & evaluation plan request — DataHarbor POC

Sean / Team —

Appreciate the quick draft. A few comments from our side after a review with engineering and security:

1) Latency target: we can accept p95 <350ms for the smoke stage, but for acceptance we need p95 <300ms on our sample flows.
2) Throughput: target should reflect peak concurrency — bump to sustain 300 req/s with 99.5% success; otherwise we'll see bottlenecks under projected traffic.
3) Security evidence: we need a short list of logs/artifacts for SOC review — audit log samples, token handling notes, and retention settings.
4) Acceptance tests: can you add a deterministic run for 500 labeled queries (we'll seed labels) so we can reproduce the quality number.

I attached a PDF with inline comments—mainly priorities rather than blockers. Also, procurement asked for a mutual signature on the MAP (simple acceptance of milestones + responsibilities).

We can take Thu 4/22 10:30 PT for the sync. Please share an updated MAP before the call.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Product, DataHarbor Inc.

Attachments: DH-eval-criteria-comments.pdf

Elena —

Thanks for the comments — they were helpful. I consolidated your asks and Karthik/Marissa mapped owners and updated thresholds. Below is the agreed MAP summary and the final acceptance check bullets we will use as pass/fail gates. I uploaded the updated MAP and the test checklist to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP (see files MAP-Draft-v2.xlsx and Acceptance-Test-Checklist.md).

Agreed MAP highlights:
- Timeline: 6-week default plan starting Mon 4/26. Kickoff on Mon 4/26 9:30 PT.
- Owners: Elena (DataHarbor) — dataset & business signoff; Karthik (Redwood) — integration and smoke; Marissa (Redwood Ops) — acceptance test runs and reporting; Sean (Redwood) — final signoff artifacts.
- Acceptance test runbook (short):
  * Deterministic quality run: 500 labeled queries, reproducible seed, pass if concordance >= 92% (DataHarbor provides labels).
  * Latency: acceptance requires p95 <300ms for the agreed traces (512 token context).
  * Throughput: sustain 300 req/s with >=99.5% success rate.
  * Failover resilience: model fallback <500ms and no data loss on retry scenario.
  * Security artifacts: sample audit logs (last 7 days), token-handling summary, and documented retention policy (Redwood to provide templates).

Exit gates:
- Gate 1 (end Week 2): Smoke pass (integration + basic latency).
- Gate 2 (end Week 4): Acceptance runbook complete (quality + throughput).
- Gate 3 (end Week 6): Executive signoff (artifacts + runbook reproducibility).

Procurement note: We will circulate a short MAP signature page after Kickoff that lists milestones and owner initials (not a full legal SOW).

Action items for the call on Mon 4/26 9:30 PT:
1) DataHarbor to provide labeled dataset and HubSpot milestone.
2) Redwood to finalize test harness and share run commands (Marissa).
3) Confirm security artifact extraction method (Karthik + DataHarbor security).

If that aligns, we'll send calendar invites and the signed MAP stub for procurement.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
